info.title: The insert verdict of an estimate

ESTIMATE_VERDICTS.description: The verdict words of an estimate: the host's judgement of adding the last uri of the line (the candidate) to the chain the others make, the second-last word of its reply. A consumer shows it and computes none.

oneOf.title: recommend
oneOf.description: Nothing the host knows speaks against adding the candidate.
oneOf.x-text: Nothing the host knows speaks against adding the candidate.

oneOf.title: warn
oneOf.description: The candidate is measured, but the chain would pass the CPU ceiling or the memory budget, or a figure the judgement needs is missing: it may still be added.
oneOf.x-text: The candidate is measured, but the chain would pass the CPU ceiling or the memory budget, or a figure the judgement needs is missing: it may still be added.

oneOf.title: notMeasured
oneOf.description: The candidate is installed but has no figure at that rate and quantum: the host cannot judge it.
oneOf.x-text: The candidate is installed but has no figure at that rate and quantum: the host cannot judge it.

oneOf.title: refuse
oneOf.description: The candidate names no plugin installed on this host: it cannot be added here.
oneOf.x-text: The candidate names no plugin installed on this host: it cannot be added here.

ESTIMATE_REASONS.description: The reason words of an estimate: why the host gave its verdict, the last word of its reply. The first that holds in this order gives it: the candidate's own code (unknown-plugin refuses, no-record and no-cell are not measured); then, each a warning, cpu-over-budget, ram-over-budget, another member's code, ram-unknown; within when none holds. unknown-plugin, no-record and no-cell are the member codes -535, -533 and -534 of the reply as words.

oneOf.title: unknownPlugin
oneOf.description: A member names no plugin installed on this host: the candidate's refuses, another member's warns.
oneOf.x-text: A member names no plugin installed on this host: the candidate's refuses, another member's warns.

oneOf.title: noRecord
oneOf.description: A member has no qualification record: the candidate's is not measured, another member's warns.
oneOf.x-text: A member has no qualification record: the candidate's is not measured, another member's warns.

oneOf.title: noCell
oneOf.description: A member's qualification records hold no figure at that rate and quantum: the candidate's is not measured, another member's warns.
oneOf.x-text: A member's qualification records hold no figure at that rate and quantum: the candidate's is not measured, another member's warns.

oneOf.title: cpuOverBudget
oneOf.description: The chain's CPU, percent of one core, is over the real-time admission ceiling of one core.
oneOf.x-text: The chain's CPU, percent of one core, is over the real-time admission ceiling of one core.

oneOf.title: ramOverBudget
oneOf.description: What the workers hold now plus what the members would add is over the host's ram_budget_mb.
oneOf.x-text: What the workers hold now plus what the members would add is over the host's ram_budget_mb.

oneOf.title: ramUnknown
oneOf.description: A member has no memory figure, or what the workers hold now cannot be read.
oneOf.x-text: A member has no memory figure, or what the workers hold now cannot be read.

oneOf.title: within
oneOf.description: Every member is measured, and the chain is within the CPU ceiling and the memory budget.
oneOf.x-text: Every member is measured, and the chain is within the CPU ceiling and the memory budget.
